Channel logo: its look, what is on it, place and size
The same menus open when you tap the scoreboard or the logo on the picture. Tap either twice to move and resize it, or hold it to drag it.

Everything about the scoreboard and the channel logo is in their own menus now: while you watch, tap the scoreboard or the logo on the picture (or Options ⋯, Scoreboard). Tap either twice to move and resize it, or hold it to drag it.
